title: Track Guide - MX5 at Oran Park South - 46.960 - iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: just before white to green wall marker, brake hard
corners.line: turn-in to middle lane, late apex
corners.exit: clip apex at fresh white line, stay tight on exit
corners.mistakes: don't rush into corner, be patient

corners.label: T2
corners.line: turn-in at striped curb on left

corners.label: T3
corners.line: straddle the kerb and white concrete infill
corners.mistakes: don't attack turn three hard to compensate for a slightly botched turn two

corners.label: T4
corners.line: use the end of the strike kerb as a marker for turning in
corners.mistakes: make sure you do the majority of changing direction before you go over the top of it

corners.label: T4
corners.line: skim the concrete infill with inside tires
corners.exit: get the throttle down after hitting the target
corners.mistakes: don't look at the curb, eyes need to be ahead

corners.label: T5
corners.line: change from slight right to slight left before hill
corners.mistakes: don't straighten up after turn 4, swoop left

corners.label: T6
corners.line: aim for the curb after coming over the hill

corners.label: T6
corners.exit: resist getting on the power until you have comfortably reached the corner apex
corners.mistakes: resist the temptation to add more steering if you think you're heading for the wall

corners.label: T7
corners.mistakes: don't put power down until you know you won't have to lift

general_tips: understanding of trail braking will have a big impact on how challenging the track is and how fast you're gonna get around it
use the concrete strip on the turn five curb as a reference point
turn 5 doesn't really exist, it's an entry curve before turn 6
use trail breaking to help curve into the turn
wait one more second before adding throttle
resist the temptation to add more steering if you think you're heading for the wall
Nail the last turn for a speed advantage on the main straight
Take the middle or inside line on the track to overtake
Use little steering input for this track and car combo
